extracted.intended_audience: project developers, public authorities and potential borrowers seeking EIB financing or partnership
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level list of thematic priorities and sectoral focus areas the European Investment Bank finances and supports, indicating the kinds of projects the EIB targets (climate, development, infrastructure, social sustainability, defence, SMEs, cohesion, etc.). Useful for applicants to align proposals with EIB strategic aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate and environmental sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: We finance climate action and environmental sustainability projects around the world to place the economy on a path to net zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The EIB is one of the largest providers of finance for climate action and focuses activities on projects that contribute to climate and environmental sustainability; see 'What we offer' and 'How our support for climate and environment works' for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development finance (EIB Global)
rubrics_metrics.description: Through EIB Global, our dedicated arm, we invest around the world to create stability, promote sustainable growth and fight climate change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB Global provides development finance and specialised offers for operations outside the EU; guidance references 'What EIB Global offers' and 'How our development finance works.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Fragility and conflict
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that address fragility and conflict, including assistance to fragile and vulnerable countries and reconstruction needs (e.g., Ukraine).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Social sustainability and fragility are central to the mission; includes targeted programmes and maps of cohesion/fragility projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation, digital and human capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest to boost technological innovation and in people (education/training) as necessary solutions to societal challenges like ageing populations and dwindling resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that enhance innovation, digital infrastructure, and human capital are priorities; see related pages on digital economy, education and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical raw materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that secure critical raw materials and associated supply chains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among strategic priorities (alongside energy, digital economy); projects that strengthen supply chains and resource security align with EIB aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital economy
rubrics_metrics.description: Finance projects that develop the digital economy and related infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital transformation and economy-strengthening investments are part of innovation/digital priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education and training
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that invest in people through education and training to boost human capital.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the innovation/digital/human capital pillar; contributes to employment and societal resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and life science
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest in health and life-science projects to strengthen health systems and innovation in life sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a sectoral focus reflecting EIB priorities in supporting societal needs and resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and defence
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure Europe's peace and security through investments in industrial base, technological superiority and essential defence infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB Group provides a one-stop-shop on security and defence; investments should contribute to industrial capacity and critical defence-related infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable energy and natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Support renewable energy and natural resources projects, e.g., developing the offshore wind sector, establishing supply chains, and electricity transmission and distribution investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB is a key player in offshore wind and electricity networks; projects that support net-zero energy transition and resilient energy infrastructure are prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture
rubrics_metrics.description: Finance agricultural projects that contribute to sustainability, food systems, and rural development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under sustainable energy and natural resources and circular economy-related activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circular economy
rubrics_metrics.description: Support initiatives that promote resource efficiency, recycling and circular economy business models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included alongside energy, forestry, solid waste and water as areas where EIB finances projects to improve environmental outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forestry
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest in forestry projects that contribute to sustainable resource management and environmental objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grouped with agriculture, energy, solid waste and water as natural-resource-related areas of activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solid waste
rubrics_metrics.description: Finance projects for solid-waste management and related infrastructure to improve environmental sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of natural-resources and circular-economy priorities; supports efficient municipal and industrial waste systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable oceans
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that protect and use ocean resources sustainably.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among environmental and resource-related financing areas; may cover maritime sectors and ocean protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Water and wastewater
rubrics_metrics.description: Finance water and wastewater projects to secure safe and sustainable water services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the EIB's natural-resources portfolio supporting essential public infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable cities and regions
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that make urban areas more sustainable, including safe, affordable, green and efficient urban transport.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes urban development, transport, social and affordable housing; aims to improve quality of life and urban resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transport (including Trans-European Networks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Finance transport infrastructure projects, including urban transport and Trans‑European Networks, to improve connectivity and sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transport is highlighted under sustainable cities and regions and as a standalone priority (Trans-European Networks listed separately).

rubrics_metrics.name: Urban development
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest in urban development projects that foster sustainable, resilient and inclusive cities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interlinked with transport, housing and regional development priorities to improve urban living conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social and affordable housing
rubrics_metrics.description: Support construction and renovation of social and affordable housing to improve living standards and inclusiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of sustainable cities/regional development objectives; addresses social sustainability and cohesion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small and medium-sized enterprises and mid-caps
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide finance and intermediated products to smaller companies that drive economic development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB supports SMEs and mid-caps together with the European Investment Fund (EIF) through a range of intermediated products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk finance through the European Investment Fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide risk finance and financial intermediary support via the EIF to mobilise private financing for businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIF partnerships and financial intermediaries expand EIB impact by channeling finance to SMEs and other target beneficiaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cohesion / Regional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Support projects that address inequalities across EU Member States by providing jobs, education opportunities, access to public infrastructure and a healthy sustainable environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aligned with EU cohesion policy; EIB projects seek to reduce regional disparities and promote inclusive growth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social sustainability (equality, human dignity, support for vulnerable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Social sustainability is fundamental: equality, human dignity and support for fragile and vulnerable countries are central to the EIB mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should respect and promote social sustainability principles; links to fragility, gender equality and human-rights priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender equality
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote gender equality as part of social sustainability objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly listed as a cross-cutting priority; projects should consider gender impacts and equality measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Uphold and promote human-rights considerations in projects and investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of social sustainability and safeguards; projects must align with respect for human rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solidarity with Ukraine / Support for Ukraine
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide immediate and reconstruction support to Ukraine following Russia's attack, addressing urgent needs and reconstruction efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB commits targeted support including the EU for Ukraine trust fund; projects should align with urgent humanitarian and reconstruction priorities.
